recognize_zh: 細胞團左側一顆巨噬細胞的空泡化細胞質內含數顆大小一致的小卵圓形酵母菌，各有透明暈與偏心深染核點，周圍為造血細胞與破碎細胞，符合播散性組織胞漿菌症。
features: Macrophage (left of the cell cluster) with vacuolated cytoplasm containing several small, uniform oval yeasts
Yeasts with a clear halo around a small eccentric dark-staining nuclear dot
Adjacent large cells with open chromatin, erythroid precursors with dense nuclei, and several smudged/disrupted cells
Thin smear background with scattered red cells and fine debris; quick stain with brownish cast
describe_en: Rapid-stained bedside smear shows a small cluster of marrow cells including a macrophage whose vacuolated cytoplasm contains several small, uniform oval yeasts with clear halos and eccentric nuclear staining. Adjacent cells include erythroid precursors, larger mononuclear cells and several smudged forms. The number of organisms in this field is limited and cell preservation is suboptimal. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma yeasts in the setting of disseminated histoplasmosis.

ddx.vs: Leishmania shows a kinetoplast beside the nucleus without a halo, unlike these halo-bearing yeasts.
Nonspecific vacuoles and debris vary in size and shape and lack a uniform oval body with a nuclear dot.
Talaromyces yeasts show central transverse septa and sausage-shaped forms rather than uniformly oval budding cells.
Candida yeasts are larger with visible budding and possible pseudohyphae and usually lack a halo.
